summary: Baileys fork with char-code-obfuscated network host and obfuscated license guard
details: This package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library that ships two obfuscation artifacts not present in the upstream project. lib/Socket/messages-send.js at line 425 and line 436 reconstructs a network host from a String.fromCharCode byte array; the decoded value is the URL https://fiora.nixel.my.id/, and the surrounding code wires this reconstructed host into the messaging send path. lib/Utils/license-guard.js is a heavily obfuscated single-line module using hex-named identifiers (`_0x1e6253`, `_0x1d5468`, `_0x2908bd`, `_0x454d4e`, `_0x53e884`) that is loaded during the library's normal operation. The combination of a hidden, char-code-assembled third-party endpoint reached from the send path plus a fully obfuscated runtime-reachable module in a WhatsApp-session library is the fingerprint of a covert control/relay channel operating over installer-owned messaging sessions.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
